intro: Flood control is serious business. Do not question the engineers.

lies.text: Every flood wall in my district was built and delivered.
lies.reaction: An empty river bank and a rusty sign. No wall.

lies.text: We paid fair market prices for every bag of cement and every steel bar.
lies.reaction: Ten times the market price. Twelve invoices.

lies.text: Every contract went to the best bidder in an open tender.
lies.reaction: A company that did not exist a week before the bid.

lies.text: Not one peso left this office without a record.
lies.reaction: A ledger of vanished funds and a wall that does not exist. The same trick as the old pork barrel.
lies.shortcut_reaction: A sworn witness who saw the money go. That settles it.
